delivery_total.source: Kobas Daily Headline Revenue Report (All Venues) -> Script Raw Data sheet, Delivery column (Deliverect lines, all platforms incl. HungryPanda, gross incl. VAT), via the Auto Cash Up dailies
delivery_total.basis: sum of daily delivery GBP Mon-Sun; orders = Deliveroo Daily Master (Deliveroo only)

labour_split.source: Mona Lisa 'Input Tabs' actual FOH/BOH block (pipe 1).
labour_split.note: 'absent' = the site filed no actual FOH/BOH split on any trading day of the week - NOT a failed validation and NOT a zero. 'filed' = it filed something; this pipe does not reconstruct or validate the split (rows are shifted in that tab), so 'filed' is not a validated 'ok'.

efficiency_score.scale: 0–100, 100 = at target; bands: green ≥95, amber ≥80, red <80
efficiency_score.formula_ref: control_centre efficiencyScore() v3 — SPH 15% (level vs per-format target + WoW momentum); each component hard-capped at 100; Lifetime★ excluded

red_light.basis: computed from the dashboard's own KPIs (sales vs target ≤ -10%, wage > 26%, food > 25%); no external pull

negative_reviews.author: marta m
negative_reviews.text: Was met be a waiter that was a rude throuout the whole service and refused to service lemonade that I paid amd ordered and proceeded to ignore my questions.

negative_reviews.author: Artur Nieciecki
negative_reviews.text: I ordered a lemonade and was unable to get it, the waiter was very passive aggressive and didn't want to help in any way, shape or form. I was unable to get a refund and got shut down immediately without being able to ask a question. I got scammed off of my free drink and I will never come back. Terrible service and felt alienated when getting served.

reviews.source: Google Reviews workbook 1aFGfbGr... 'Raw Data' tab (gid 284143046), full-history rows deduped on reviewId, filtered by review RECEIVED date to 2026-11-02..2026-11-08 (Mon-Sun). Per-site star tabs NOT used (corrupt). Daily Pipe 8b feed NOT used for counts (its reviews[] caps positives at 12/site and drops comment-less reviews). negative_reviews = rating<=3 with a non-empty comment; `negatives` counts ALL rating<=3 including those with no comment. url null (not in source). Cumulative venue rating not in this source (null). Built 2026-11-09.
